Subject: RE: Story idea 
 
Hi Anthony,
Thanks for putting this in an email and we will be back in touch with you on your request.

From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> 
Sent: Wednesday, April 15, 2020 1:18 PM
To: Ron Colangelo <Ron.Colangelo@tigers.com>
Cc: Al Avila <Al.Avila@tigers.com>
Subject: Story idea
*** This email originated from an EXTERNAL source ***

I'm working on a story for Sunday's paper about how Tigers people are adjusting to baseball's shutdown and what their typical days are like now as compared to during the season. I'm trying to talk to people in all corners of the organization - players, coaches, executives, baseball operations, scouting, media relations, broadcasters, etc. - to get a picture of how things have changed.

Ideally, I'd like to speak with Al, Scott Pleis and Doug Teter. I'm not trying to go too in-depth with each person; think more along the lines of day-to-day questions with a nugget of information. For examples: Al (How has your workload changed? Is your wife getting sick of you at the house? What, from your perspective, is the biggest impact of the shutdown to your organization?); Pleis (How does this impact your draft? How weird is it to be at home with the family at a time you would be traveling?); Teter (What is it like in Lakeland now? How much have you learned during this process? What is your typical day like during the break?)
I wouldn't need more than 10 minutes with each person. Let me know if this is possible and if you guys have any additional questions.
